scope: The source inventory covers all local entries and explicitly catalogued external texts. It is not an exhaustive catalogue of Catholic teaching.

priorities.title: Review inherited source groups
priorities.note: Establish document identity, issuing body, translation and dates from primary sources before treating inferred groups as verified documents.

priorities.title: Complete local Vatican II texts
priorities.note: All 16 documents have official complete-text links. Eleven have local selections. The five external-only documents need reuse review and checked transcription before becoming locally searchable.

priorities.title: Preconciliar papal teaching
priorities.note: Rerum Novarum, Quas Primas, Mediator Dei and Humani Generis have source records and full-text links. Extend one pontificate and genre at a time, beginning with Leo XIII, Pius XI and Pius XII.

priorities.title: Additional papal teaching
priorities.note: Lumen Fidei, Sacramentum Caritatis, Salvifici Doloris, Vita Consecrata, Rosarium Virginis Mariae, Laudate Deum and Dilexit Nos are accessible externally; their complete texts have not been ingested.

priorities.title: Episcopal and Eastern Catholic teaching
priorities.note: Select collections with explicit jurisdiction, approval and provenance rather than attempting an undifferentiated archive.

feedbackPolicy: No background analytics or automatic transmission of searches. Research gaps are saved only when you choose, on this browser. You can delete them or choose to open a GitHub proposal yourself. Corrections, proposals and scheduled link-check reports guide future priorities.
